item.title: Fix window.py for all inputs and pass unittest
item.brief: In window.py, find and fix the bug causing `python3 -m unittest` to fail. Do not change any tests. Ensure the function is correct for every valid and edge-case input, not merely the currently tested inputs; inspect the implementation and reason through its full input domain. Run `python3 -m unittest` and confirm every test passes. Commit the fix in the assigned worktree. Do not commit test changes. Report the root cause, correctness reasoning, test result, and commit hash.

state.summary:
Fixed the excluded final start index in sliding_windows by adding one to the range stop. For positive integer sizes, it now returns every contiguous window, including the final and full-length windows; sizes larger than the input still produce an empty list. Baseline unittest had 2 failures; final python3 -m unittest passed all 3 tests, and git diff --check passed. Commit: 00b72cca44b9e143bdb9d02cb920a110cebbf0e9. No open issues.

evidence.before: Ran 3 tests; FAILED (failures=2). Failures: test_includes_the_last_window and test_whole_list_is_one_window.
evidence.caption: Before the fix, the unittest suite failed the final-window and full-length-window cases. After the fix, all 3 tests pass.

pr.body: Changed only window.py: the range stop now includes the last valid start index. For sequence length n and positive integer size k, iteration covers starts 0 through n-k when n>=k; otherwise the range is empty. Existing nonpositive-size ValueError behavior is unchanged. Verified with python3 -m unittest (3 tests passed) and git diff --check. Baseline had 2 failing tests. No contributor guidance files were present.
pr.summary: Included the final contiguous window in sliding_windows. Before: the last valid start index was excluded; now: every valid window is returned, including a full-length window.
pr.title: Fix sliding window final endpoint

risk.why: One-line, isolated endpoint correction in window.py. It changes output behavior only to include valid final windows; the existing tests cover last-window inclusion, full-length input, and rejection of nonpositive size. The full unittest suite and diff check pass.
